svg.title: Kern Fig. 18 — LMTD correction factor F_T, 1-2 exchanger
svg.text: Kern Fig. 18 — LMTD correction factor FT, 1-2 exchanger
redrawn from the exact 1-2 formula; one curve per R
1 shell pass, 2 or more tube passes
R = (T₁ − T₂)/(t₂ − t₁) on the curves
Mark S = 0.222 on the S axis.
Go straight up to the R = 2.67 curve (between the printed 2.5 and 3.0).
Go across to the FT axis.
Redrawn from the correlation; in the exam read the printed chart — values may differ slightly.
